ITEM 1 | Bright yellow-gold cubes with slightly irregular edges and a pale, fibrous-looking cut surface, moist and firm, forming the largest cluster on the left and top of the bowl; cubes roughly 2–2.5 cm per side, piled 1–2 layers deep | 95
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow chunks, a bit softer and more rounded-edged than the other yellow pieces, sitting in the center-top of the bowl; pieces about 1.5–2 cm, moist surface | 45
ITEM 3 | Bright yellow cubes, slightly glossy and juicy, clustered on the right side of the bowl; pieces about 2 cm per side, stacked up to two high | 60
ITEM 4 | Deep red strawberry pieces with a glossy, slightly wet surface and white-pale core visible at cut edges; wedges and halves about 2–3 cm, scattered through the bottom-center and right of the bowl | 55
ITEM 5 | Small dark blue-black berries, smooth and glossy skins, roughly 1–1.5 cm diameter, scattered along the left and right rim of the bowl, about 5 berries | 10
ITEM 6 | Juice or moisture: no distinct pooled liquid visible; faint wet sheen on fruit surfaces only, so no separate liquid item | 0
